A closer look

TEAM CODEX ACCESS
01 /

One place for account assignments.

Admins import and assign accounts or account pools, with organization permissions, usage-quota tracking, and activity records in the management system.

02 /

A clear entry point for members.

Members sign in with their CodingCTO account or email and password. The client handles device binding and retrieves the assigned access package before launch.

03 /

Work in the local Codex App.

The dedicated desktop client manages isolated authentication directories and starts the separately installed official Codex App on the member’s computer.

GET STARTED

See whether it fits your team.

CodingCTO is designed for small teams that need a central way to assign Codex access and a consistent sign-in flow for members. Core workflows are implemented; release validation is still in progress.

Product preview

The source repository is private and no public installation package has been published on this site. Follow FastAGI’s public project activity on GitHub.

Visit FastAGI on GitHub

A few useful details.

Who is CodingCTO for?

Small development teams and technical studios that need to manage Codex account assignments and member access. Independent developers can use the wider FastAGI toolkit and explore CodingCTO when they start working with a team.

Does it replace the Codex App?

No. Members install the official Codex App separately. CodingCTO provides the management console and a dedicated client that signs members in and launches that local app.

Can I download it or view the source?

Not publicly yet. The source repository is currently private, and this website does not provide a public download or self-service signup. This page introduces the documented product workflow.
